answer: Proof of Stake functions as a Sybil resistance mechanism by tethering identity to capital, forcing an attacker into a costly spiral of asset accumulation. By treating the validator set as a crystal structure of trust, the protocol ensures that an actor cannot easily inflate their influence without significant economic outlay. This system replaces the ivory tower of centralized gatekeeping with verifiable skin in the game, where the cost of a Sybil attack scales linearly with the total value at stake.
